✔ Kreis passt auch: Alle 26 Kinder zusam: ✔ Kreis (pie) fits too: all 26 children together are the whole. Each piece shows a part of it.
✘ Linie passt nicht. Eine Linie verbinde: ✘ Linie (line) doesn't fit. A line connects points and shows a change over time. But nothing changes between “bus” and “bike”!

✔ B6 stimmt: 404 € im Jahr. Jetzt ausfül: ✔ B6 is correct: 404 € a year. Now fill. Tip for one formula for everything: =12*B$2+$A6*B$3/100
{} von 9 stimmen. Beim Ausfüllen wandern: {} of 9 are correct. When filling, the references wander off. Fix rows 2 and 3 (B$2, B$3) and column A ($A6).

Familie mit 4 Personen, 5000 kWh: Welche: Family of 4, 5000 kWh: which provider is cheapest?
